story.en: A corridor mechanism repeats every four beats. It sounds on beats 1, 2 and 4; beat 3 stays silent. Recreate that recorded pattern, including its pause. Keep every sound short. Pitch and timbre are already set.
story.zh-Hant: 走廊裝置每四拍循環：第 1、2、4 拍發聲，第 3 拍安靜。請重建這段包含停頓的紀錄，每聲保持短促。音高與音色已設定。

0.en: Silence is part of the evidence. Leave beat 3 empty rather than filling every beat.
0.zh-Hant: 沉默也是證物的一部分。第 3 拍應留白，不要每拍都加音。

0.en: Use three short attacks in four beats. An extra attack in the pause lowers progress; submissions remain unlimited.
0.zh-Hant: 四拍內有三次短促起音；在停頓處多加一聲會降低進度，仍可不限次提交。

0.en: Each beat is four cells. Keep cells 8–11 empty and leave gaps between the short sounds.
0.zh-Hant: 每拍四格，第 8–11 格應留白，短音之間也要有空隙。

0.en: Start cells 0, 4 and 12, with length 1 each. The gold timing marks are now visible.
0.zh-Hant: 三個音從第 0、4、12 格開始，各長 1 格；金色節奏標記已顯示。

completion.en: CASE CLOSED: sound, sound, silence, sound. You preserved the missing beat instead of covering it up.
completion.zh-Hant: 案件結論：響、響、停、響。你保留了空白的一拍，沒有把它掩蓋。
